"### Chart Description: EMBIG Sovereign Spread

This line chart tracks the sovereign spreads (measured in basis points) for Emerging Markets and Argentina from July 2023 to May 2024. It utilizes a dual-axis system to compare the two datasets.

#### Chart Metadata
| Element | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Title** | EMBIG Sovereign Spread |
| **Unit** | Basis points |
| **Primary Y-Axis (Left)** | Emerging Markets (Scale: 250 to 500) |
| **Secondary Y-Axis (Right)** | Argentina (Scale: 1100 to 3100) |
| **X-Axis (Bottom)** | Time (Monthly intervals: Jul-23 to May-24) |

#### Legend and Axes Values
| Legend Item | Color | Corresponding Y-Axis | Values Shown on Axis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Emerging markets** | Dark Blue | Left | 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500 |
| **Argentina (rhs)** | Light Blue | Right (rhs) | 1100, 1600, 2100, 2600, 3100 |

#### X-Axis Labels (Timeline)
*   Jul-23
*   Aug-23
*   Sep-23
*   Oct-23
*   Nov-23
*   Dec-23
*   Jan-24
*   Feb-24
*   Mar-24
*   Apr-24
*   May-24

#### Visual Trends and Data Summary
*   **Emerging Markets (Dark Blue Line):** Starts near 350 basis points in July 2023, peaking around 420 in late September/October 2023. It then follows a general downward trend, reaching a low of approximately 280 in April 2024, before ending May 2024 with an uptick toward 340.
*   **Argentina (Light Blue Line):** Fluctuates around 2000-2100 basis points initially. It sees a significant peak above 2600 in September 2023. Following this, it shows a sharp and sustained decline, narrowing significantly compared to general emerging markets. It hits a low point near 1100-1200 basis points in late April/early May 2024, finishing the period slightly higher near 1300-1400.
*   **Correlation:** While both lines follow a broadly similar downward trajectory starting in late 2023, the decline in Argentina's spread is much steeper relative to its own scale, indicating a "narrowing" as suggested by the context."
